title: Yesteryear's Lanterns and the Guhua of Today
description: Sun Yu and Little Que'er seem to want to release a Xiao Lantern...

mainQuestExcel.title: Yesteryear's Lanterns and the Guhua of Today
mainQuestExcel.description: Sun Yu and Little Que'er seem to want to release a Xiao Lantern...

dialogs.text: If I release a lantern around here, the adepti might see it, right? But with these materials...
What are you doing?
Ah, I'm sorry, my junior and I were just considering the matter of releasing a Xiao Lantern.
The trouble is that we don't quite have sufficient materials on hand...
But if you are willing, friend...
There you go again... Guhua this, Guhua that...
The Lantern Rite only comes once a year, and all you can think to make a wish about is the Guhua Clan...
Are we not both disciples of Guhua? It falls to us to revive the Guhua Clan to its former glory.
Yes, Brother... whatever you say, Brother...
Excuse me, friend. Would you, perchance, be willing to fetch some Xiao Lantern materials for me?
Sure.
I salute you.
Ahem. So, I've checked over everything. It seems like we're still missing a Qingxin...
The last ones we picked have since dried out and turned brittle...
You can make Xiao Lanterns from Qingxin?
Heh, it's an unorthodox method that my fellow Guhua disciples and I once came up with when we were bored and had nothing else to do.
But there is something rather nice about Xiao Lanterns scented with flowers.
I shall await you here. Please bring the materials here once you have found them. You have my thanks.
Your fellow disciple might have something to say about that...
No, it was nothing! No, whatever he wants, that's fine by me...
*sigh* Sister...

flow.stepDescription: Give the Qingxin flowers to Sun Yu

dialogs.text: I shall await you here. Please bring the materials here once you have found them. You have my thanks.
Thank you! We should be able to make a Xiao Lantern now.
It's done, Que'er. Inscribe our wishes on this lantern later, if you will, for your handwriting has always been very good...
Sure, sure. I'll do the writing.
Que'er... Are you... displeased, by any chance? What's the matter?
Oh no, I'm not displeased at all. In fact, I couldn't be more happy to help release this lantern...
*cough* Ahem! So, uh, where were you planning to release that lantern?
Wh—Why, uh, yes! Indeed, friend, you speak the truth — we should do exactly that.
Okay, you can go if you want. I won't join you, though. It's a hard climb and I don't have the energy.
But... But we've been resting here for a sufficiently long time, I do believe...
Uh, I've got a headache coming on. I don't know, maybe I caught a cold from this mountain air. It was a bit windy just now.
...Please, allow me.
I... ...*sigh* If you would be so kind, my friend. In fact, I had originally planned to release it from a very specific location...
Back when the Guhua Clan still... well, existed, an elder disciple would take me there to release a lantern every Lantern Rite.
Sadly, the Clan has since met its demise. No practitioner of Guhua has set foot in that place to release a lantern in a long time...
Since you offer your aid, my friend, I shall not refuse it. Please, go there and release this Xiao Lantern on my behalf.
I shall mark the location for you. Meanwhile, I need to take care of my fellow disciple...
I'll release the lantern for you!
Ahem. You should go release your lantern.

flow.stepDescription: Go to the old Guhua Clan spot to release the lantern

dialogs.text: Are you quite alright? How did you suddenly develop a headache... Do you need any medicine?
No, uh, no need... Just stay with me for a bit, I'm sure it'll pass...
You're here... to release lanterns?
None but the members of the Guhua Clan know of this spot, and yet your faces are unfamiliar...
I'm here at someone's behest.
There are those of the Guhua Clan who still remember this place?
I saw no one when I first arrived, and that saddened me, I must admit...
But it gladdens my heart to know that there are still those of the Guhua Clan that remember this place.
The Guhua Clan used to release lanterns here?
Yes... We would craft our lanterns, then an older disciple would bring us here. They'd lead the way, and we'd follow behind with our lanterns in hand.
Back then... Xiao Lanterns from all over the mountain would merge into one in the sky. It was a wonderful sight.
But now...
...Let's release the lantern first. If you have the time, we can discuss the past further as we walk.
I remember that there was once when, on the occasion of our releasing lanterns, a high-spirited senior demanded a match with me.
I had yet to make reply when a trusty female junior of ours stealthily poured water on the ground where he stood.

With the ground so wet and slippery, our elder disciple had not even drawn his sword before taking one step, slipping and falling, and landing right on his buttocks. I laughed so hard that I promptly followed suit.
He was not angry, he just pointed at me and laughed. Everyone else gathered around and laughed along...
I don't know where he is today...

I also once saw a glimmer of hope. It was a young boy who had just joined the Guhua Clan. He was handsome, well-mannered, and exceptionally talented. It seemed like he would be the one to revive the tradition.
But he was a difficult one to track down, and no one would see a glimpse of him for long periods... *sigh* I guess I never should have put my hopes in him.
Better to let him go, and not hold out for his return.
When I left the Guhua Clan, there were barely any disciples left.
Master did not blame me. He just told me to live a good life.
But now, I don't know whether I have lived a good life...
...Or just... made it through life, with little to show for it.
I've heard people say that a Guhua disciple called Sun Yu is currently visiting the mountain, and that he seeks to revive Guhua.
If only I had his courage...
Sorry, I'm prattling away, aren't I... It's good to come outside once in a while, get some fresh air, and get some things off my chest...
You seem a little down.
Oh... I'm fine. It's just... this time of year.
Anyway, it's getting a little late. Happy Lantern Rite, and... please, could you pass on a message to the one who sent you with the lantern? The message is this:
...The message is... Um...
...Um, um... "Happy Lantern Rite, from Zhiruo," I suppose.
Happy Lantern Rite to you, too.
Thanks. Take care of yourself.

flow.stepDescription: Report back to Sun Yu and Little Que'er

dialogs.text: Ah, you're back. Did you release the Xiao Lantern?
About what happened when we released the lantern...
I see. Yes, Zhiruo... I remember her. She took good care of me back then.
And she still remembers the Guhua Clan. I am pleased...
How is Little Que'er?
Ah yes, Little Que'er's headache is getting better. Perhaps she had just caught a cold, I'm now preparing to...
Brother, about that person Zhiruo you were speaking of just now...
Was she your senior in the Guhua Clan? Was she good-looking? Were you two close?
Oh well, I can't say I knew her too well... But Zhiruo was quite adept at healing wounds. Whenever anyone was injured, we'd always go straight to her.
Hahaha, now that I think about it, there were probably many that fancied her in the Guhua Clan.
And how about you, Brother?
Oh, uh... I...
Brother, you and Zhiruo... what's your relationship, exactly?
Uh... We aren't very close, really. You could say we share the fated fellowship of our clan...
Oh... Then what about the relationship between you and me?
Hahaha, why, we also share the fated fellowship of our clan, of course!
Que'er? Is... is there something wrong?
